title: Custom Drug Dilution Assay (version 2)
author: Opentrons
materials: Specify your parameters on this page.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Define experimental parameters
steps.instruction: Set the protocol parameters: choose the Number of Dilution Plates (3 or 4) and decide whether to enable the optional Add Cells + Media? step.

steps.title: Prepare deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map: place the stock plate in slot 10, the reservoir in slot 11, and the 3 or 4 dilution plates in the designated slots; load tip racks for the p300‑multi (columns 1 and 2) and the p10‑multi.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the p300‑multi (GEN1) and p10‑multi pipettes as described in the support article.

steps.title: Add initial media to dilution plates
steps.instruction: With the p300‑multi, use tips from column 1 to dispense media from the reservoir: add 100 µL to columns 2‑12 of the first two dilution plates and 90 µL to columns 2‑12 of the last plate. After every four transfers, return the tips to the tip rack and pick them up again to ensure a good seal.

steps.title: Perform drug dilutions
steps.instruction: Using the p10‑multi, transfer 10 µL of each drug from the stock plate (slot 10) to the dilution plates, accessing only columns 2‑11 (leaving column 1 empty and column 12 without drug). Use the same tip for all columns of a given dilution.

steps.title: Add final media (or cells + media)
steps.instruction: With the p300‑multi and tips from column 2, dispense 100 µL from the reservoir (slot 11) to columns 2‑12 of all dilution plates, following the same tip‑reuse pattern as the initial media addition. If the Add Cells + Media? option is selected, dispense the 100 µL 2 mm above the well bottom; otherwise dispense at the standard height.

steps.title: Download and upload protocol
steps.instruction: Click “Download your protocol” to obtain the Python script, then upload it into the OT App via the “Upload protocol to OT App” button.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated liquid‑handling sequence.
